You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Client Service Priority Consultant
Company: FirstRand
About the company: RMB is a place where exceptional people create their own opportunities by challenging the conventional and driving sustainable impact. United by our proud heritage and strong ethics. Innovative ideas, it’s the magic of our people and culture that sets us apart.
Purpose of the role: This role entails providing dedicated, expedited services to priority clients, ensuring their needs are met promptly and effectively. Operating across various client communication channels and prioritise queries, resolve issues and coordinate with internal teams to provide exceptional client experiences. Maintain and strengthening long-term priority relationships and promote loyalty to the organisation.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Service and the primary point of contact for Priority Clients, delivering personalised and expedited service through various client communication channels.
  - Prioritise incoming inquires and requests from Priority Clients, ensuring swift resolution and timely responses.
  - Anticipate client needs and proactively address potential issues or concerns.
  - Proactively identify opportunities to cross-sell or upsell based on client needs and preferences.
  - Liaise with internal stakeholders, including product specialists and relationship managers to expedite solutions and ensure seamless client experiences.
  - Advocate for Priority Clients within the organisation, escalating issues and advocating for solutions that align with client expectations and company policies.
  - Monitor SLAs and performance metrics to track response times and service quality, identifying opportunities for improvement
  - Conduct regular check-ins with Priority Clients to gather feedback, address concerns and identify opportunities to enhance the client experience.
  - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline processes, eliminate bottlenecks, and optimise efficiency in serving priority clients.
  - Stay informed about industry trends, market developments to anticipate client needs and recommend relevant solutions.
  - Handle escalations from other client service representatives, providing guidance and support to ensure timely resolution and client satisfaction.
  - Document client interactions, inquiries, and resolutions accurately in the relevant system, maintaining comprehensive records for future reference and analysis.
  - Participate in training and development programmes to enhance product knowledge, communication skills and service delivery capabilities.
Must-have requirements:
  - a Bachelor of Commerce in Business Administration
  - 4 to 5 years' experience in Client Services Support and Delivery
Location: Johannesburg
Benefits:
  - Opportunities to network and collaborate
  - Challenging Work
  - Opportunities to innovate
Closing date: 2026-11-11
How to apply / contact: Apply now!
Employment equity statement: All appointments will be made in line with FirstRand Group’s Employment Equity plan.
Accessibility statement: The Bank supports the recruitment and advancement of individuals with disabilities. In order for us to fulfill this purpose, candidates can disclose their disability information on a voluntary basis. The Bank will keep this information confidential unless we are required by law to disclose this information to other parties.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Client Service Priority Consultant

FirstRand

Johannesburg

About us
RMB is a place where exceptional people create their own opportunities by challenging the conventional and driving sustainable impact. United by our proud heritage and strong ethics. Innovative ideas, it's the magic of our people and culture that sets us apart.

About the role
You provide dedicated, expedited service to Priority Clients, making sure their needs are met promptly and effectively. Working across client communication channels, you prioritise queries, resolve issues and coordinate with internal teams to deliver strong client experiences. You maintain and strengthen long-term priority relationships and build loyalty to the organisation.

What you'll do
• Act as the primary point of contact for Priority Clients, delivering personalised and expedited service across various communication channels
• Prioritise incoming enquiries and requests from Priority Clients so they are resolved swiftly and answered on time
• Anticipate client needs and address potential issues or concerns before they escalate
• Identify opportunities to cross-sell or upsell based on client needs and preferences
• Liaise with internal stakeholders, including product specialists and relationship managers, to expedite solutions and keep client experiences seamless
• Advocate for Priority Clients inside the organisation, escalating issues and pushing for solutions that match client expectations and company policies
• Monitor SLAs and performance metrics to track response times and service quality, and flag opportunities to improve
• Conduct regular check-ins with Priority Clients to gather feedback, address concerns and find ways to improve their experience
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline processes, remove bottlenecks and improve efficiency in serving priority clients
• Stay informed about industry trends and market developments so you can anticipate client needs and recommend relevant solutions
• Handle escalations from other client service representatives, giving guidance and support until matters are resolved
• Document client interactions, enquiries and resolutions accurately in the relevant system for future reference and analysis
• Take part in training and development programmes to build product knowledge, communication skills and service delivery capability

What you need
• A Bachelor of Commerce in Business Administration
• 4 to 5 years' experience in Client Services Support and Delivery

What we offer
• Opportunities to network and collaborate
• Challenging work
• Opportunities to innovate

Closing date: 2026-11-11

The Bank supports the recruitment and advancement of individuals with disabilities. In order for us to fulfill this purpose, candidates can disclose their disability information on a voluntary basis. The Bank will keep this information confidential unless we are required by law to disclose this information to other parties.

All appointments will be made in line with FirstRand Group's Employment Equity plan.
